assay: small RNA-seq (miRBase mature miRNA counts) of serum EV-enriched fraction, Illumina NovaSeq 6000 (S2.5.p2, S2.6.p1)
primary_estimand: Within-subject change in serum EV-enriched miRNA abundance at mid-AAE, immediately post-AAE and 75 min post-AAE relative to pre-AAE baseline, in adults with MDD after one 30-min moderate cycling bout (S2.2.p1, S2.7.p1). Single arm, no resting control (S4.5.p4).
inclusion: 30 pre, 29 mid, 28 post, 28 75-min samples after 10 library failures; no outliers removed (S2.5.p2, S2.6.p1)
planned_contrasts: mid vs pre (S3.3.p2; paper: 15 DE, 13 down / 2 up)
post vs pre (S3.3.p2; paper: 33 DE, all down)
post75 vs pre (S3.3.p2; paper: 4 DE, all up)
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.44 ~ ID + Treatment, Wald tests, BH; size factors from unfiltered matrix; keep miRNAs with >=10 normalized counts in >=3 samples; non-converging genes (2%) excluded (S2.7.p1)
paper_results: 15/33/4 DE at FDR<=0.05; 2,609 miRNAs after filtering (S3.2.p4); Table 1
